response.overview: Based on the actual 2019 earthquake in Albania. “3:54 AM” follows a group of survivors trapped beneath the rubble of a collapsed apartment building following a 6.4-magnitude earthquake that struck in the middle of the night. As the hours pass and rescue efforts struggle to reach them, hope and despair collide in the darkness—and survival becomes a question of who can hold on until help arrives, if it arrives at all.
